# Production's resolved package set — the GitHub-hosted backend jobs install
# backend/requirements.txt with `-c` this file, so a pull request is tested
# against exactly what the live container runs, not whatever PyPI resolves today.
#
# backend/requirements.txt keeps its ranges: the deploy image resolves them at
# build time and buildx caches that layer until requirements.txt changes — so any
# byte change there (even a comment) re-resolves every package in the next
# production image, and this file must then be regenerated after that deploy.
#

# Regenerate: .github/ci/refresh-constraints-from-prod.sh (read-only on prod).
